findings.title: Row D-13 (`structural_kdf::derive_root` info-tag codepoint-binding) verified DEFERRED-correctly at HEAD; `aead_wrap::make_key_material_matching` chunk-codepoint inheritance from first-chunk does NOT defeat per-chunk typed-reject
findings.evidence: Row D-13 at V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE-DEFERRED.md:309-326 names `derive_root` info-tag missing the cipher-suite codepoint as a `~5 LOC + golden test` G-COMP-1 deliverable + acknowledges the natural ChaCha20-Poly1305 defense at v1-beta. At HEAD `4bbc4cac` `crates/benten-crypto-suite/src/structural_kdf.rs:124-129` `derive_root` info = `'root' || root_cid` (no codepoint) — UNCHANGED from R4 — properly deferred per Row D-13. Inspected `crates/benten-graph/src/aead_wrap.rs::make_key_material_matching` at :507-525 (the docstring at :500-506 acknowledges the threading): the function reads codepoint from `chunked.chunks.first().map_or(HYBRID_X25519_MLKEM768, |e| e.cipher_codepoint)` for the Chunked variant — verified that downstream per-chunk codepoint mismatch IS still caught by `benten_crypto_suite::aead::unwrap` at `aead.rs:288-293` ('if envelope.cipher_codepoint != key.codepoint { return Err(AeadError::Unsupported(...)) }') BECAUSE the key material's codepoint is fixed once but each chunk's cipher_codepoint is compared per-envelope at unwrap-time — so a heterogeneous-codepoint chunk sequence WOULD trip the per-chunk typed-reject at the mismatched chunk. Additionally `ChunkedCiphertext.chunks` is `pub(crate)` (`crates/benten-graph/src/aead_wrap.rs:214`) so out-of-crate code cannot construct a heterogeneous-codepoint chunk sequence directly. Net: Row D-13 disposition is correctly load-bearing for the future-K_root-divergence hardening; the v1-beta posture as deferred has no exploitable structural hole at HEAD.
